title: a LOT of Seville
text:
This was a great way of seeing a LOT of Seville in a just short of 3 hours of wandering. Very interesting historical chats without it feeling boring at all. Filippo, our guide was excellent. 

It was a private tour for 8 of us and was excellent value for money.
author: Dave-Mads

title: Great way to learn the city
text: Our guide, Rosa, was great- she knew her stuff.  She 'read the room' and gave the right amount of information on the sites.  Fun experience to walk around the city to places we likely would not have go to on our own.  She also gave us tips on other places to visit.
author: C2089APcathyr

title: Great Seville city tour
text: Great tour in a wonderful city.  Elena was great. We had an early morning tour before the city was too busy.  She was quite knowledgeable about the city and its history.  There was a good bit of walking which was fine for us.  Elena was good at popping in to little nooks and crannies of the city that one would just walk past.  She provided context to the importance of why she brought us to these places. title: Perfect way to see the city
text: I booked the Orientation tour to help us get to know Seville in the small time we had there this weekend for my friend’s hen weekend .Susana was a wonderful guide and she was really knowledgeable of the history of Sevilla and I learnt loads a lot about the city but also the Holy Week celebrations, Flamenco, and the architecture of the city. Susana listened to all my requests. Thank you.
author: elliesaprice
